mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 65 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park, and we are under a new moon. Tonight, the temperature will reach a low of 63 degrees with no rain expected.

City Hall has released the fall 2026 election notices for the upcoming general election on November 3. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy program.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. On September 13, Verona hosts the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, and next week, you can join in for trivia at Hop Haus or Paddy Mac's.

On September 10, Verona police responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way. Officers apprehended a nineteen-year-old suspect, recovering a handgun and shell casing, though no injuries were reported from the firearm discharge.
Today's flavor was Raspberry Cheesecake. Since the store is now closed for the night, you can look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Caramel Cashew, when the shop opens at 10:00 AM.
